description: Configuration properties for the container deployment model.

incremental_snapshot.description: If enabled, the autoconf module will attempt to publish and push configuration snapshots after every 'Deploy Pending Changes' request. This is useful if subsequent configuration steps require a previous snapshot state: eg. the revery proxy wizards often require the runtime container to be started wit ha valid configuration snapshot to load the self-signed x509 certificate. Enabling this property will increase the time required to apply the defined configuration.
